## Chemical Formulations and Safety Protocols
We exclusively utilize HACCP-recommended, eco-friendly formulations strictly adhering to advanced Integrated Pest Management (IPM) guidelines:
- Synthetic Pyrethroids: AlphaMethrin (specifically AlphaMethrin, not alpha cyper methrin), Cypermethrin, and Deltamethrin.
- Systemic and Residual Insecticides: Imidacloprid, Chlorpyrifos, and Propoxur.
- Fumigants and Rodenticides: ALP (Aluminum Phosphide) and Zinc Phosphide.
## Services

Super Pest Control Services provides termite and wood borer control, general pest control, rodent management, vector control and fogging, bed bug eradication, commercial fumigation, fly management systems, sanitization and disinfection, commercial AMC/IPM programs, and customized help for other pest problems.

## Industries and Facilities Served
We provide targeted, audit-compliant pest management for a diverse range of environments:
- Food and Beverage: Restaurants, Cafes, and Food Processing Units
- Hospitality: Hotels, Resorts, and Guest Houses
- Commercial and Retail: Supermarts, Shopping Malls, and Retail Stores
- Storage and Logistics: Warehouses and Distribution Centers
- Corporate and Institutional: Banks, Financial Institutions, and Corporate Offices

## Certifications
- IAF ISO 9001:2015 Certified
- NIPHM Certified (National Institute of Plant Health Management)
- IPCA Certified (Indian Pest Control Association)
- Government Approved and MSME Registered
- GST Registered Entity
